lines: Taylor's carries fell to 12.3 per game over the last 3 weeks from 17.7 on the season, and his snaps dipped to 66% from 76%.
The coach said the Colts plan to lean on the run, especially early downs, while Taylor keeps sharing carries with McGowan.
Wk 11 is at HOU, where IND's implied team total is 16.0 points. HOU allows the 15th-most PPR points per game to RBs.
